module_summary: MII PHY interface: RX path captured by a source-synchronous SDR input child, TX path registered in IOB flops on the forwarded tx clock, plus per-domain reset synchronizer shift registers.

anchors.name: phy_mii_rxd
anchors.why: PHY receive nibble captured by SDR input child with dv/er.

anchors.name: mac_mii_rxd
anchors.why: Registered receive nibble delivered to the MAC.

anchors.name: mac_mii_txd
anchors.why: MAC transmit nibble registered into IOB output flop.

anchors.name: phy_mii_txd_reg
anchors.why: IOB register driving PHY transmit data on tx clock.

anchors.name: phy_mii_rx_dv
anchors.why: PHY receive data valid, captured alongside rxd.

anchors.name: mac_mii_rx_dv
anchors.why: Registered receive data valid to MAC.

anchors.name: mac_mii_tx_en
anchors.why: MAC transmit enable registered toward PHY.

anchors.name: phy_mii_tx_en_reg
anchors.why: IOB register driving PHY transmit enable.

anchors.name: phy_mii_txd
anchors.why: PHY transmit data port driven by IOB register.

anchors.name: phy_mii_tx_er_reg
anchors.why: IOB register driving PHY transmit error.

anchors.name: tx_rst_reg
anchors.why: Shift-register reset synchronizer producing mac_mii_tx_rst in tx clock domain.

anchors.name: rx_rst_reg
anchors.why: Shift-register reset synchronizer producing mac_mii_rx_rst in rx clock domain.

groups.name: rx_capture
groups.description: SDR input child buffers PHY rx clock and registers rxd/dv/er for MAC.

groups.name: tx_output_regs
groups.description: IOB flops registering MAC tx signals on the forwarded PHY tx clock.

groups.name: reset_sync
groups.description: Per-domain reset synchronizers for MAC rx and tx resets.
